svg.title: What the invoice page's ⋯ menu holds
svg.text: What the invoice page's ⋯ menu holds
The record ⋯ on the title line (RecordMoreMenu): the stage's own move first, Copy link, then Not an invoice in red after a line.
Approve stays in the bar; the menu only clears junk.
Back to review reopens the fields for a fix; Mark paid stays in the bar.
No bar: nothing left to do. Undo paid puts it back in To pay; Not an invoice is gone once it's paid.

g.text: Paid Nov 24 by Baselane transfer, Connor
Paid Nov 24 by Baselane transfer, Connor
Paid Nov 24 by Baselane transfer, Connor

svg.text: Not an invoice goes at once with a toast and Undo (like Archive), and hides the invoice from contractors.
Copy link copies the invoice page's address, as on every record page.
On touch the ⋯ menu stays anchored under its button with 44px rows; it never becomes a sheet.
